test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 7 girls G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 and G7 are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). G4 is not next to G6. G2 is not next to G1. G6 is second to the left of G3. G1 is third to the right of G3. G7 is third to the right of G6. Considering towards left of G4, how many girls are sitting between G4 and G6?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given: G1, G2, G3, G4, G5, G6 and G7 are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre.

G6 is second to the left of G3.

G7 is third to the right of G6.

G1 is third to the right of G3.

G2 is not next to G1.

G4 is not next to G6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40cde782f5665eb497ad8d3307e6bb7f79fd42ab5e229db04bfdbd91c1598262.png] 

So, there are 3 girls sitting between G4 and G6.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
